rule.description: UserAccount entitlement: do not match existing accounts
rule.comment: When using the User Account entitlement with the Identity Manager user application or Role Based Entitlements, accounts are created and deleted/disabled by granting or revoking the entitlement. Default policy does not match an existing account in Oracle E-Business Suite if the user is not entitled to an account in Oracle E-Business Suite. Modify or remove this rule if you want entitlement policy to apply to matching accounts in Oracle E-Business Suite. Notice that this may result in the Oracle E-Business Suite account being deleted or disabled.
